items.name: all
items.title: All
items.description: Installs every Orchid UI component via registryDependencies.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: Class-name helper (cn). Merge Tailwind classes. Import from @/lib/utils, not as a UI widget.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary actions: save, cancel, delete, icon-only, split menus. Props: type Primary|Secondary|Destructive (looks only; use htmlType for submit), style Default|Border|Transparent, size Small|Default|Big. Not tabs or links in a nav.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Overflow or grouped actions on a trigger (Edit, Delete, filters). Use DropdownMenu + Trigger (render Button) + Content + Item. Not for choosing one value from a long list — use select.

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snack Bar
items.description: Short feedback after save/error (toast or inline banner). color Default|Blue|Red|Orange|Grey. Not a permanent page alert — use empty-page or a Field error.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Programmatic snackbar stack. toast.add({ title, description, type }). Mount Toaster at the app root. Visual is Snackbar, not a generic card.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Status, tags, filters, removable tokens. Chip colors + type Background|Border|Transparent. UserChip for Owner|Admin|Manager|Cashier. Not a button; not Badge from shadcn.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expand/collapse sections (FAQ, extra details, progress per item). AccordionTrigger title/description/label/progress. Not tabs — use tab-menu for switching views.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Show completion of a known total (70/100, upload, wizard). size Default|Small, value/max. Not a loading spinner for the whole page.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: One row in a list: title, meta, thumbnail, hover edit/delete, copy id. selected = highlighted card. Use for rosters, webhooks, integrations — not a data table.

items.name: input-stepper
items.title: Input Stepper
items.description: Integer quantity (capacity, count). Minus/plus; click the number to type. min/max/step. Not a slider and not a plain text input for money.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Person or business face. size 24–64, type Default|Business|Image. Initials as children; src for a photo. Pair with names, not as a logo block.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover/focus hint on an icon or truncated label. TooltipProvider + Content side. Not a popover with buttons — use popover or dropdown-menu.

items.name: tab-menu
items.title: Tab Menu
items.description: Switch views on one page (Week | My shifts | Review). type Default underline or Pills. TabMenuList + TabMenuTab + TabMenuPanel. Not a dropdown of actions.

items.name: clickable-option
items.title: Clickable Option
items.description: Pick one option as a card (plan, shift slot, payment method) without a radio dot. ClickableOptionGroup. Not a checkbox list and not select.

items.name: overview-item
items.title: Overview Item
items.description: Dashboard KPI: icon, title, value, percent badge. iconColor Blue|Green|Red|Grey. Grid several on a home/overview page. Not a list row — use list-item.

items.name: sub-header
items.title: Sub Header
items.description: Top bar on a nested screen: Back or Close + right-side buttons. Put page-title below, not inside. Not the app sidebar.

items.name: page-title
items.title: Page Title
items.description: Page heading: title, optional chip/status, description, copy id, action buttons. Sit under sub-header; box-detail below. Not a card title inside a list.

items.name: section-title
items.title: Section Title
items.description: Form section heading: 16px title, 12px description, optional chip, hint, count, and actions. Pair with Field/Input via Section; settings rows use SectionItem. Not a page heading — use page-title.

items.name: box-detail
items.title: Box Detail
items.description: Read-only key/value details (shift time, customer fields) in one card. type Default or Border table. Grid + colspan. Not an editable form — use field + input.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Tight cluster of icon actions (copy, open link, more menu). type Default|Border. Not a full toolbar of labeled Buttons.

items.name: copy-tooltip
items.title: Copy Tooltip
items.description: Copy a string (id, phone, URL) with a Copied! tooltip. Pass value. Use on ids and contact fields, not as the only way to duplicate a whole record.

items.name: customer-card
items.title: Customer Card
items.description: Customer or beneficiary summary: name, email, phone, address, avatar. variant Small|Big|Float|Empty. Empty + onAdd when none selected. Not a generic user list row — use list-item for long lists.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Multi-select yes/no options (permissions, extras). CheckboxGroup Vertical|Horizontal. For one on/off setting use toggle. For one-of-many use radio-group or select.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Exactly one choice from a short list (alignment, role). Radio inside RadioGroup. For many options use select; for cards use clickable-option.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: On/off setting (notifications, publish). size Default|Small. Not a checkbox in a form list of many items.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or range on a track (0–100, price band). Array value = two thumbs. Not for counts with exact integers — use input-stepper.

items.name: empty-page
items.title: Empty Page
items.description: No data / no search hits / upgrade CTA. type Default|Search|Upgrade + actions Buttons. Use when a list or page has zero rows — not for inline field errors.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible label next to a control (htmlFor). Prefer FieldLabel inside Field for forms.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visual divider between blocks. orientation horizontal|vertical. Use instead of hr or border-t divs.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder bars. Pulse on oc-neutral-soft. Shape via className (size-8 rounded-full, h-4 w-full). Not a spinner.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form row: label, control, hint, error. FieldGroup + Field + FieldLabel. data-invalid on Field, aria-invalid on the input. Wrap every form control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text (name, email, amount as text). Use with Field. Prefix/icon → input-group, not a positioned Button.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line notes (issues, leftover work, description). Use with Field. Not for chat transcripts.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one from a list (status, staff, currency). Select + Trigger + Value + Item. Inline size for currency inside input-group. For many values with search, use combobox. Not radio cards — use clickable-option.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable list (tags, staff, countries). Combobox + Input + Item. Multiple: ComboboxChips + Chip. Checkbox variant and ComboboxSelectAll for bulk pick. Grouped: Group + Label + Collection. Not a closed single pick without search — use select.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Input plus prefix, suffix, or inline select (currency, URL, search icon). InputGroupInput/Textarea inside — never raw Input. Addon align start/end.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Small panel on click (date, extra filters) that is not a full modal. Trigger render Button. For hover hints use tooltip; for page dialogs use modal.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid only. Prefer date-picker for forms. Use calendar when you embed a month in a custom layout. mode single|range|multiple.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Pick a day or a date range in a form (shift date, week range). DatePicker or DatePickerRange. Not a full-page calendar widget.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Focused task overlay: create/edit shift, confirm delete, handover form. Modal + Trigger + Popup. Always set title. size Small|Medium|Default|Confirmation (320/480/640). persistent = no backdrop close. Not a side sheet (none in kit).

items.name: confirmation-modal
items.title: Confirmation Modal
items.description: Prebuilt confirm overlay on Modal. type Delete|Warning|Success|Question. size Small|Medium. Optional confirmPhrase to type before delete. Use ConfirmationModalContent as the inner block.

items.name: form-builder
items.title: Form Builder
items.description: Schema-driven form on TanStack Form. Pass defaultValues + fields (input, textarea, select, toggle, checkbox). Renders Orchid Field. Not a generic layout grid.
